results.title: Nigeria Approves ₦40.76bn Healthcare Fund, Extends Insurance to 90,000 Inmates
results.snippet:
### Description
92 views
Posted: 2026-10-16
The Nigerian Government has approved ₦40.76 billion for the third-quarter 2026 disbursement under the Basic Health Care Provision Fund, up from ₦32.88 billion in the previous quarter. Coordinating Minister of Health and Social Welfare Professor Muhammad Ali Pate says the funding will support affordable healthcare for vulnerable and underserved Nigerians.
